title: The bird on the ruler
logline: The steel ruler on the drafting table, unused since the grid ended, and the bird standing on it, the length of it, every color on the one straight thing in the room.

panels.composition: A steel ruler lying on a drafting table under the lamp with the small rainbow bird standing on it, a blank sheet beside it, the blue pencil.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a steel ruler lying on a drafting table under a lamp with a small rainbow bird standing on it, a blank sheet and a blue pencil beside, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
